metadata.title: Galexi
metadata.description: An admin-managed global dictionary with public vocabulary flashcards.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We could not load this page. Try again, or return home.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page or vocabulary entry you requested does not exist or is not available.

home.heading: Keep new words in orbit.
home.description: Study a shared dictionary of pronunciations, meanings, and examples maintained by administrators.
home.secureDescription: Administrators maintain the dictionary while every learner can study published words.
home.wordsDescription: Study pronunciations, Thai meanings, example sentences, and useful image links.
home.languageDescription: Built with internationalization from the start, with English enabled today.

start.title: Start learning in a few taps
start.description: Choose your goal and current level so Galexi can prepare the right learning path for you.
start.guestNote: Your progress is saved to a private Guest session on this device.

goal.title: Why are you learning English?
goal.description: Choose the one that matters most right now. You can change it later.

daily_conversation.title: Daily conversation
daily_conversation.description: Speak more naturally in everyday situations.

travel.title: Travel
travel.description: Navigate trips and connect with people confidently.

school_exam.title: School or exams
school_exam.description: Build vocabulary for study and test preparation.

level.title: How does English feel today?
level.description: Pick the closest match. There is no test and no wrong answer.

starter.title: Just starting
starter.description: I know a few words and simple phrases.

beginner.title: Beginner
beginner.description: I can understand and use basic sentences.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.description: I can handle familiar conversations and texts.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: I communicate well and want more precision.

ready.title: You are ready for your first lesson
ready.description: Your learning preferences are saved. Galexi will use them when the first lesson experience is added.
ready.nextDescription: The lesson experience is the next focused feature. Your setup will be waiting when it is ready.
